jobs.title: Jobs

first.title: Let’s find your first posting
first.body: Paste a link from LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday or any careers page. Job-alert emails and the browser extension will bring more here.

nothingNew.title: Nothing new to look at right now
nothingNew.body: Everything you saved is already in Applications. I’ll put new links from your job-alert emails and your browser here as they come in.

noMatch.title: No matching postings
noMatch.hint: Try fewer words or clear a filter.

leads.title: Job leads
leads.description: {count, plural, one {# posting from your job alerts, browser and searches, not saved yet. Import one to read and check it.} other {# postings from your job alerts, browser and searches, not saved yet. Import one to read and check it.}}
leads.noText: No posting text was saved with this lead. Open the original to read it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Group jobs your own way, for example by search or priority. Filter by tag on the Jobs page.

overview.title: Job description
overview.description: Original text, kept unchanged. Treated as untrusted input by every AI step.

salary.title: Pay
salary.similar: {count, plural, one {# similar posting with a salary} other {# similar postings with a salary}}
salary.middleHalf: Middle half of {count, number} Adzuna postings
salary.inLine: In line with what similar roles pay.
salary.above: About {diff}% above what similar roles pay.
salary.below: About {diff}% below what similar roles pay. Worth raising when you negotiate.
salary.noPay: This posting doesn’t say what it pays.
salary.addMarket: <link>Add market data</link> to compare with other employers.

period.hour: The posting gives a rate per hour. Turned into a yearly figure (1,607 hours) for comparison.
period.day: The posting gives a day rate. Turned into a yearly figure (218 days) for comparison.
period.month: The posting gives a monthly amount. Turned into a yearly figure (12 months) for comparison.

jobs.description: Postings to look at before you commit: from job-alert emails, your browser and links you paste. Track one to start its application.

discover.added: {count, plural, one {# new posting in your leads} other {# new postings in your leads}}
discover.partial: Some searches failed; these are the results of the others.
discover.wait: This takes a minute or two. You can keep working.
discover.setupHelp: It needs your own Apify token to search LinkedIn and Indeed.
discover.where: They are in your job leads, best matches first.
discover.seen: Everything found was already in your jobs or leads, or outside your search goals.

jobReader.worksWith: Works with {boards} and any careers page. Behind a login? Use Paste text, or the browser extension.
jobReader.textPlaceholder: Paste the full job description, including the company name and role.
jobReader.more: {count, plural, one {# more character} other {# more characters}}
jobReader.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved until you check it.
jobReader.title: Add a job
jobReader.description: Paste the link to the posting. Naruvi reads it, finds the company’s own website and logo, and lets you check everything before saving.

newJob.reviewDescription: Fix anything the reader got wrong, then save the job.

source.link: found in a link on the posting
source.guess: guessed from the name and verified on the site

newJob.savedBody: Check your fit whenever you’re ready.

dup.similar: This looks like a job you already have
dup.sameBody: Saving again updates the existing job with this text; your analysis and documents stay.
dup.similarBody: Same company and a very similar title. Open the existing one, or save this as a separate job if it’s a different opening.

newJob.detailsBody: Everything here is editable. Fix anything the parser got wrong before saving.
